learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Hyperventilation Activation.
Apply Hyperventilation Activation to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Three minutes of deep breathing can increase diffuse slowing, especially in children, and may activate some generalised epileptiform discharges.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Response depends on age, effort, blood glucose and cerebrovascular physiology. Contraindications and local medical protocols must be followed.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Activation can add diagnostic yield in conventional EEG when medically indicated.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Calling normal hyperventilation build-up “encephalopathy” is a classic interpretive error.

reviewPrompts.answer: Response depends on age, effort, blood glucose and cerebrovascular physiology. Contraindications and local medical protocols must be followed.
Activation can add diagnostic yield in conventional EEG when medically indicated.
Calling normal hyperventilation build-up “encephalopathy” is a classic interpretive error.
Activation responses must be judged against age, effort and recovery.
